question: A function $f$ is said to be odd if $f(-x)=-f(x)$ for all $x$. Which of the following is not odd?

options.A: A function $f$ such that $f(x+y)=f(x)+f(y)$ for all $x,y$
options.C: $f(x)=x-[x]$, where $[x]$ denotes the greatest integer which is less than or equal to $x$

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10+2 Level
